entries.source: A problem has occurred with your display driver. Your system may not have enough resources to run the game at the selected settings. You can retry using the same settings, or adjust them to lower settings. Make sure you have the latest drivers for your video hardware, and try rebooting your system to help clear up any issues.
entries.translation: Hiba lépett fel a képernyő-illesztőprogrammal. Lehetséges, hogy a számítógép nem rendelkezik elegendő erőforrással, hogy futtassa a játékot a választott beállítások mellett. Próbáld meg ismét ugyanezekkel a beállításokkal, vagy állítsd azokat alacsonyabbra. Gondoskodj róla, hogy telepítve legyen a legfrissebb videovezérlő, és indítsd újra a számítógépet az esetleges rendszerhibák megszüntetéséhez.

entries.source: (LARA, reading from her journal) In Egyptian mythology, the god-king Osiris unified the kingdoms
entries.translation: (LARA a naplójából olvas) Az egyiptomi mitológiában Ozirisz istenkirály egyesítette a királyságokat,
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: and ruled with wisdom and justice over the whole of Egypt…

entries.source: until he was killed by his brother, the usurper Set.
entries.translation: míg fivére, a trónbitorló Széth meg nem ölte.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: Osiris’ wife, the Goddess Isis, recovered her husband’s lifeless body.

comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: Using the power within the staff of Osiris, she returned him to the world,
entries.translation: Ozirisz botjának erejével visszahozta őt az élők közé,
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: but only long enough to conceive a son, Horus.
entries.translation: de csak annyi időre, hogy megfoganjon a fiuk, Hórusz.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: When Set learned of her actions, he stole the staff and used its power to imprison Isis and Horus.
entries.translation: Amikor Széth tudomást szerzett erről, ellopta a botot, és erejével foglyul ejtette Íziszt és Hóruszt.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: Then he seized the reanimated form of Osiris, tore his body into pieces and scattered them across the land,
entries.translation: Aztán megragadta Ozirisz újjáéledt testét, darabokra tépte, és szétszórta az országban,
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.translation: így többé senki sem szállt szembe egyiptomi uralmával.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: As his kingdom declined, he descended to the underworld, Duat, in search of greater power.
entries.translation: Ahogy királysága hanyatlott, leszállt az alvilágba, a Duatba, hogy nagyobb hatalomra tegyen szert.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: But Osiris alone possessed the power to return from Duat,
entries.translation: Ám egyedül Ozirisz rendelkezett a Duatból való visszatérés erejével,
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: and without the staff, Set found himself trapped for eternity.
entries.translation: és a bot nélkül Széth örökre foglyul esett.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: The Temple of Osiris remained sealed for thousands of years, until I discovered a way inside…
entries.translation: Ozirisz temploma évezredeken át lezárva állt, míg rá nem jöttem, hogyan juthatok be…
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: ... But I was not alone. Carter Bell, a rising star in archaeology, was also in search of the Staff.
entries.translation: ...De nem voltam egyedül. Carter Bell, a régészet feltörekvő csillaga szintén a botot kereste.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: The lost Staff of Osiris was inside. With our prize so close, the race was on...
entries.translation: Odabent rejtőzött Ozirisz elveszett botja. A cél már karnyújtásnyira volt, és megkezdődött a verseny...
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.
First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: CARTER: Ha! Not this time, Croft!
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: (LARA) But it was too late. The staff was a trap, and the temple a prison.
entries.translation: (LARA) De már késő volt. A bot csapda volt, a templom pedig börtön.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.translation: Carter és én átok alá kerültünk.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: ISIS: We owe you our thanks, travelers, you have freed us from our prison.
entries.translation: ÍZISZ: Hálával tartozunk nektek, utazók. Kiszabadítottatok a börtönünkből.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: ISIS: But you are now marked for Judgment. You do not have much time.
entries.translation: ÍZISZ: De most rajtatok az ítélet jele. Nincs sok időtök.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: ISIS: Duat, the realm of the dead, awaits.
entries.translation: ÍZISZ: A Duat, a holtak birodalma vár rátok.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: ISIS: I am Isis and this is my son, Horus.
entries.translation: ÍZISZ: Ízisz vagyok, ő pedig a fiam, Hórusz.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: ISIS: We are the last of the old gods who stood against Set.
entries.translation: ÍZISZ: Mi vagyunk az utolsók a Széth ellen forduló régi istenek közül.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: ISIS: If you wish to live, we must escape this Temple and find the pieces of Osiris.
entries.translation: ÍZISZ: Ha élni akartok, ki kell jutnunk ebből a templomból, és meg kell találnunk Ozirisz testrészeit.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.
First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.
First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: OSIRIS:  I do not have long, Isis.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: You have restored much of my power, but I belong in the Land of the Dead now.
entries.translation: Erőm nagy részét visszaadtátok, de már a holtak földjéhez tartozom.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: HORUS:  Father, you cannot leave, not again.
entries.translation: HÓRUSZ: Atyám, nem mehetsz el! Nem veszíthetünk el újra!
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: OSIRIS:  It is the way of the world, my son.
entries.translation: OZIRISZ: Ez a világ rendje, fiam.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: Set will try to break free, and Duat will not hold him forever.
entries.translation: Széth megpróbál majd kiszabadulni, és a Duat sem tarthatja fogva örökké.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.
First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: HORUS:  If he does, we will be here. We will stop him again.
entries.translation: HÓRUSZ: Ha megteszi, itt leszünk. Újra megállítjuk.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: OSIRIS:  You must be forever vigilant.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: Mortals. You have done the work of gods this day, and for that, I owe you everything.
entries.translation: Halandók! Ma az istenek munkáját végeztétek el. Ezért mindennel nektek tartozom.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: You are free of Set's curse -
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: Free to choose your own path...
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: My family, know that I will watch over you.

comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: Keep me in your hearts until I return.
entries.translation: Őrizzetek meg a szívetekben, amíg visszatérek.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: CARTER:  Well Croft, I suppose I owe you an apology. If I hadn't touched the staff...
entries.translation: CARTER: Nos, Croft, azt hiszem, bocsánatkéréssel tartozom. Ha nem nyúltam volna a bothoz...
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: LARA:  Water under the bridge, Carter.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: I suppose it would have been me, had I been ahead...
entries.translation: Azt hiszem, én tettem volna meg, ha előbb odaérek...
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: CARTER:  Don't you dare tell anyone this, but... it was a hell of an honor to work with you.
entries.translation: CARTER: El ne merd mondani senkinek, de... pokoli nagy megtiszteltetés volt veled dolgozni.
comment: First Hungarian draft; contextual proofreading and in-game verification pending.

entries.source: LARA:  Your secret is safe with me. And... likewise.
